full.description: This clinical photo displays the hand of a newborn infant. The image reveals a supernumerary digit, or an extra finger, located on the ulnar side of the hand with a ligature applied to its base. Additional features include multiple prominent creases across the palm. The overall presentation is characteristic of polydactyly.

blind.description: This is a clinical photograph of a human foot viewed from the plantar surface. The image reveals multiple supernumerary digits, showing at least seven toes in total. The structural abnormality represents polydactyly of the foot. The surrounding soft tissues appear otherwise intact without acute inflammatory changes.

random.description: This is a clinical photograph showing the hand of an infant with unusual palm creases. The image displays the palmar surface of the hand and wrist. Multiple abnormal creases are visible across the palm. These findings are characteristic of congenital developmental anomalies, such as those associated with Down syndrome.
